test_title: PYST 11: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A cylindrical concrete pillar has a radius of 0.5 m and a height of 4 m. If the curved surface is to be plastered at ₹180 per m², what will be the total plastering cost for 12 such pillars?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Cost = Number of pillars × (2 × π × r × h) × Rate

Total Cost = 12 × (2 × 3.14 × 0.5 × 4) × 180

Total Cost = 12 × 12.56 × 180

Total Cost = 150.72 × 180 = 27129.60

**∴ The correct answer is ₹27,129.60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius (r) = 0.5 m

Height (h) = 4 m

Number of pillars = 12

Rate of plastering = ₹180 per m²

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cylinder = 2 × π × r × h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2ed62208868906f8622c6a4ab5bda17c3baddaf3da59b91315581dd8af09aad.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ CSA of one pillar = 2 × 3.14 × 0.5 × 4

⇒ CSA of one pillar = 12.56 m²

⇒ Total CSA for 12 pillars = 12 × 12.56

⇒ Total CSA = 150.72 m²

⇒ Total Cost = Total CSA × Rate

⇒ Total Cost = 150.72 × 180

⇒ Total Cost = ₹27,129.60

**∴ The correct answer is ₹27,129.60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Cylinder

The total surface area includes the curved surface and the two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(h + r).

Volume of Cylinder

The amount of space occupied by the cylinder: Volume = πr²h.

Area of Circular Base

The area of one flat end of the cylinder: Area = πr².
